author: Coding agent (authoring pass)
why: REQ-17 says discounts round to the nearest cent, with half-cents rounded up. The shared pricing function rounded the discount down.
before: A 105-cent order at 10% gets a 10-cent discount. Total 95 cents.
after: A 105-cent order at 10% gets an 11-cent discount. Total 94 cents.
preserve: At zero discount the total stays 105 cents.
approach: In applyDiscount(), add 50 before the integer division by 100 so half-cents round up. Whole-cent integer maths only.
rollback: Revert the PR commits. No data migration.
